message.content: Small product loose-ends in /opt/nxeon (Next.js 15). Do NOT edit prisma/schema.prisma, do NOT run git, do NOT touch anything under app/admin, terminal-server/, scripts/, or lib/actions-improvements. Read files before editing; match existing style. Keep changes tight and verified. 1. **Web terminal on the server detail page**: the web terminal currently only lives on the Claude Code hub. Add an "Open terminal" button to the server detail page for a RUNNING server so customers can open a shell straight from the server view. Read `app/dashboard/servers/[id]/page.tsx` and `components/customer/ServerTabs.tsx` to see the layout, and `components/customer/WebTerminal.tsx` for the component's props (it needs the server's `{id, hostname, connect}` list — build a single-item list for this server, computing `connect` the same way the claude-code page does: dedicated IP → `ssh root@`, else `ssh -p root@`). Mount `WebTerminal` behind the button. Only show it when the server status is RUNNING. Reuse the existing component; do not duplicate its logic. 2. **Footer social links**: `components/marketing/MarketingFooter.tsx` renders decorative (non-linking) social icons. Make them real links WHEN configured: read `NEXT_PUBLIC_SOCIAL_TWITTER`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SOCIAL_GITHUB`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SOCIAL_DISCORD` env vars — for each that is set, render an ``; for each that is NOT set, keep the current decorative non-linking span (so no dead links). Don't invent URLs. 3. **Marketing LCP image**: on the marketing homepage (`app/page.tsx`) and/or the primary hero, if there are any `` tags for above-the-fold imagery still using raw ``, convert the single most-prominent one to `next/image` `` with `priority` for a better LCP. If everything is already `next/image` or there's no hero image, skip this and say so. Do NOT mass-convert or risk layout regressions — one careful, correct change or none. Verify: `cd /opt/nxeon && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | grep -v "test/.*test.ts"` clean for your files and `npm run build` exits 0. Report exactly what you changed in each of the 3 areas (or why you skipped one).
